NDT Products & Supply

NDT Products & Equipment Supply

Radiography Equipment

Industrial Gamma Radiography Equipment & Cameras

Remote control gamma radiography projectors (Iridium-192, Cobalt-60, Selenium-75), drive cables, source guide tubes, and collimators.

AERB / BARC Approved Designs
Depleted Uranium / Tungsten Shielding
High Safety Interlock System
Ultrasonic Products

Ultrasonic Thickness Gauges & Digital Flaw Detectors

Portable dual-element A-scan thickness gauges, High-Temperature probes (up to 500°C), and multi-channel Phased Array flaw detectors.

Sub-millimeter Accuracy
A-Scan & B-Scan Data Logging
Ruggedized IP67 Enclosure
Calibration Standards

Calibration Blocks & Reference Standards

ASME, API, and IIW calibration blocks (V1, V2, Step Blocks, DAC blocks) manufactured from certified carbon steel, stainless steel, and alloy stock.

EN 10204 3.1 Material Certificates
EDM Notch & Flat Bottom Hole Precision
Serialised Traceability
